title: Write the local refusal summary after its requester is deleted
outcome: A retained local unclassified refusal remains readable through the run summary when the original requester was deleted, without redirecting a notice or reopening producer delivery.
acceptance: With a present run directory and deleted requester, bounded presentation repair writes the final refusal mirror and summary exposes its retained reason; requester notice completion is independent of mirror completion.

Behavioral tests cover deletion before repair and after reload, a missing run directory and a recoverable mirror-write failure. They preserve no notice redirection, no producer route/send, no credit and bounded retry/retirement.
Focused checks cover affected consumers and helpers; the exact landing input passes the required full gate and independent review pair.
